name: Defective Detectives
source:
The Mayor's daughter has lost her pet hamster, Fluffy. Seems like a simple matter? Not so!

The best of the worst take on the investigation:

• Detective Johnson: A veteran cop who's too old for this crap, but whose mortgage won't pay itself.

• Intern Billy: A walking disaster. A man capable of starting a shootout in an empty room and losing.

Together, they must navigate a hell of idiocy, interrogate witnesses who saw nothing, and uncover a terrible secret. Fluffy isn't just a cute little furball. He's a criminal mastermind who founded an underground "Hamster Diaspora" with the goal of taking over the planet!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4410920/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
市长的女儿失去了她的宠物仓鼠毛绒。看起来是一件很简单的事情？不是这样的！

对调查的最好和最坏的看法：

• 约翰逊警探：一位经验丰富的警察，年纪太大了，不适合做这些废话，但他的抵押贷款却无法偿还。

• 实习生比利：一场行走的灾难。一个能够在空荡荡的房间里发起枪战并失败的人。

他们必须一起穿越愚蠢的地狱，审问什么也没看到的目击者，并揭开一个可怕的秘密。蓬松不仅仅是一个可爱的小毛球。他是一名犯罪策划者，创立了地下组织“仓鼠侨民”，目标是占领地球！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4410920/]Steam[/url]]
